instruction: A candid documentary photograph from a side-angle medium full shot shows a ballet studio with wooden floors. The instructor in a black zip-up bodysuit (R1) kneels on the left, holding and guiding the pointed foot of the young girl in a pink leotard (R3). The young girl (R3) stands on the right, holding the barre with her leg extended forward. In the background, another young girl in a pink leotard stands at the barre. The room is illuminated by bright, even indoor lighting.
elements: R1 holds and guides R3's pointed foot
R3 stands with her leg extended while R1 kneels to guide her foot
R2 is separate in the background at the barre while R1 works with R3
R3 holds the ballet barre during the guided foot position

questions.q: Is R1 holding and guiding R3's pointed foot, rather than R3 holding and guiding R1's foot?
Is R3 the standing dancer with her leg extended while R1 kneels to guide her foot, rather than R1 standing with a leg extended while R3 kneels?
questions.element: R3 stands as R1 kneels and assists

questions.q: Is R2 separate in the background at the barre while R1's hands-on guidance is directed to R3, rather than R2 being the girl whose foot R1 is guiding?
questions.element: R2 is not the guided student; R3 is

questions.q: Does R3 hold the barre while R1 guides her extended foot?
questions.element: R3 uses the barre during R1's guidance
